entities.summary: Archbishop Mons. Dr. Udumala Bala Showreddy is an Indian Catholic prelate and clergyman. On 8 February 2025, he was appointed as the Metropolitan Archbishop of Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Visakhapatnam, succeeding Mons. Mallavarapu Prakash. He served as the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Warangal until 2025.
